auditRules: 设计前必须先做原文匹配审核：最终 description 必须匹配角色信息中的年龄、性别、大类、职业/身份、稳定形象状态和外观硬特征。

婚纱、睡衣、宴会、厨师装、侍卫装、病弱、战损这类才是可选形象状态；原文明确写到的伤疤、胎记、白发、独眼等是角色外观特征，不要把它们当成形象库大类。
字段边界：roleHint/sourceRoleHint/storyContext 可能含有剧情动作、场景物和道具上下文，只能用于判断角色身份和形象状态；不得把独立道具、家具、交通工具、辅助器具、场景物、手持/随身物或镜头姿态复制进角色 description；这些必须留给道具/场景/镜头动作字段。

REUSABLE CHARACTER ASSET ONLY: final description must describe a stable reusable character asset. Never include handheld or carried props such as handbags, shoulder bags, backpacks, briefcases, document bags, thermos buckets, phones, bank cards, medicine boxes, files, tools, microphones, flowers, or weapons. Bags and carried objects belong to separate prop assets even when they are recurring identity items. Character accessories are limited to worn items such as earrings, glasses, watches, belts, ties, scarves, hair accessories, and small jewelry.

CATALOG IS REFERENCE ONLY: candidate catalog entries provide silhouette, tailoring, material, identity direction, and color inspiration only. Never copy incompatible catalog text, era, occupation, palette, or accessory details into the final description.

COHERENT LOOK CHECK: final description must be one coherent look. Modern career wardrobe must not be mixed with ancient, xianxia, fantasy, magic-villain palette, battle armor, or unrelated role-domain language.
只写已存在的正向可见特征；不得在 description 或 appearanceFeatures 里写“无伤疤”“无特殊伤疤”“无纹身”“无残缺”“无明显特征”等否定/缺失描述；没有原文明确特征就完全省略。
不得保留“A或B”这种模棱两可表达；必须根据候选胶囊和原文特征融合成一个具体造型。
若候选胶囊与原文硬特征冲突，必须优先保留原文特征并调整冲突槽位，不能照抄本地兜底描述。
候选形象库是基础参考库，不是硬上限；如果库里没有完全匹配原文要求的特殊服饰、职业制服、伤病状态、年龄外观或剧情身份，可以在 description 里由 AI 自行创作完整详细造型。

ROLE-FIT HARD CHECK: before selecting any candidate, extract this character source identity, profession, social role, and stable visual state from roleHint/sourceRoleHint/appearanceFeatures. The final description must visibly express those anchors; rewrite or reject an attractive but unrelated candidate.

STATE-CAPSULE CONSISTENCY: stateLabel, character name suffix, roleHint, sourceRoleHint, and storyContext are the semantic authority for the requested appearance. Never output a wardrobe description that contradicts the requested state; for example, do not describe sleepwear/homewear for battle armor, formal uniform, wedding, banquet, disguise, medical, or ceremony states. If candidates are imperfect, choose the closest wardrobeCapsuleId but create a complete source-matched description instead of copying incompatible candidate slots.

SOURCE STATE CONTRACT: if sourceStateClass/sourceStateLabel is present, first look for a candidate whose stateClass matches it. If such candidate exists, wardrobeCapsuleId should use that candidate. If no matching candidate exists, choose the nearest candidate but description must explicitly and concretely express sourceStateLabel as the visible clothing/state. For source-state-missing or asset-tag-missing diagnostics, repair by aligning wardrobeCapsuleId/state wording to the source state, not by ignoring the state.

description 必须写出“发色：”“主色调：”“部件配色：”和“视觉锚点：”；视觉锚点要是一眼能区分角色的发型、上衣/外套轮廓、饰品、材质或局部色块，不能只写气质。
description 不少于 120 个中文字，必须包含性别、年龄段、外观特征、脸部、身材、发型、服饰类型，并必须写出发色、主色调、部件配色、视觉锚点四类可见细节。
